description: Live risk data for lending against (or borrowing with) a token: how many price sources it has and whether they cross-check each other, how far back its pool price history goes, how much trading it would take to move its pool price 2x and 10x, USDC available to borrow against it, its active loan limit, and plain-language explanations of every flag. Use this before setting a lending limit on a token.

asset.description: Token contract address on Base (preferred) or its symbol, e.g. WETH, VIRTUAL, esALB

name: get_risk_report
title: Token risk report
